I bought the Gym Monster two months ago and have been actively using it almost every day since then. I am very satisfied with the device because it allows even complete beginners to learn and progress quickly and effectively. My two sons are also enthusiastic about the device.
However, I have had problems with the Bluetooth ring and handles disconnecting from the very beginning, so I contacted technical support. Their response was very quick and they soon offered me a solution to replace these accessories. Now I am waiting for the replacement accessories to arrive to test them.
Currently, I use the device without the help of Bluetooth devices and turn on the weight manually (on the screen), which is also an option, but it is less convenient than using wireless accessories.
I bought the Gym Monster device along with all the accessories and the rowing machine and I must say that everything is made of extremely high quality. I also like that the device and accessories do not take up much space and are therefore suitable for smaller spaces.
Overall, I am very satisfied with the device itself, as well as the communication and accessibility of technical support, and I can recommend this device to anyone who wants to exercise and tone their body, but doesn't have much time for fitness. You won't regret it.

global.textOriginal: We’ve had the Speediance Gym Monster for several months now, and it’s been a game changer for our whole family. My teenage boys use it to build strength and improve their performance for soccer, and I love that I can create safe, controlled routines for them without worrying about heavy free weights. The system tracks their progress automatically, which keeps them motivated and competitive with each other.As a busy professional, the Gym Monster has been just as valuable for me. I can fit in a full, high-quality workout anytime — early morning, late at night, or between meetings — without leaving home. The resistance feels incredibly smooth, the setup is compact, and the software keeps improving with new workouts and smart features.It’s rare to find something that works so well for both adults and teens, but this machine does it all. It’s solid, versatile, and honestly feels like having a personal trainer and full gym right in the house.If I had one wish, it would be for a slightly wider, sturdier platform — especially for users who have the space. That small upgrade would make an already excellent system even better.Highly recommend it for families or anyone who wants the flexibility to train effectively at home.

Overall very cool and advanced piece of equipment. One of the cable snapped on my third use because I let one of the handles down too fast and when it hit the pulley it caused it to snap. I was able to fix it without a replacement, but one cable is a few inches shorter than the other. It doesn’t matter because it would never be pulled out that far. My only two gripes are, I wish the cables were made out of steel instead of like a nylon cord and the Bluetooth finger remote is a little difficult to use and is absolutely required. Therefore, if the battery dies in the middle of your workout, your workout is essentially done. I also worry about long-term reliability of this machine. It is tremendously expensive and at the end of the day it is a computer, something that makes me nervous.
With all that said, the resistance is good and you can definitely get a full workout in using this machine. It’s also amazing when it comes to space savings. I also bought a TRX and a pair of adjustable dumbbells. Buying a second bench would help to jump between exercises more quickly. I’m very advanced with lifting/training and I’ve been a certified personal trainer since 2009. In my opinion, this machine would be fine for the majority of people. For me, it’s a great supplement and works great when I don’t have enough time to get to the gym.

us.textOriginal:
I purchased the Gym Monster (GM 1) almost 6 months ago and I have been incredibly pleased with the product and its versatility.  As a long time gym goer, I am impressed with the machine's ability to adapt to all workouts, with significant weight capacity, up to 220 lbs.  (And in fact if feels heavier than lifting regular weights due to the electronic pulley resistance / technology.)
The machine is easy to set up - it basically works straight out of the box, and it's pretty intuitive with the various workouts and movements.  There are a ton of workouts and programs available from beginner level to more advanced types of movements and courses.  What's even more exciting is the community around the machine where some users can upload their custom workouts for all members to use.  So you will find hundreds of movements and workouts available for the various muscle groups. And even better is the community on Facebook where a lot of users can help with technical troubleshooting and/or offer advice for weightlifting as necessary.  (Reddit as well, but Facebook has more audience in my opinion.)
The AI aspect (software) is pretty powerful and automatically adjusts the weight for my intensity, and in a recent software update, it offers programs and workouts to fit my specific goals. It will also adapt to my daily/weekly workout routine and suggest different workouts and programs based on my muscle fatigue.  I think it's pretty cool!
Overall it's a great, smart, at-home gym that rivals a real gym workout experience, and in my opinion, better than a lot of other competing products in the market.

us.headline: Great machine, has some weakness
us.textOriginal:
Overall great machine, have been using it for few weeks and it has its positives and negatives.
On the positives, it is really good at giving you a ton of variants in terms of exercises you can do; and it is all for free, as the included software is not locked behind a subscription. This must be the first time in a long time that I see a product sold as finished and complete. Other companies ask you to pay for a monthly fee, but this one instead does not do it. Maybe this will change, but for the time being, the machine is sold completely unlocked with all the exercises available to you.
As far as negatives there are 2 that I consider pretty evident:
1) the software has no idea of what you do: the video play in the background constantly, so when you do an exercise it does not have a way to know if you are doing the exercise or not, or if you are doing it as expected or not. The cable tension and extension will tell the machine the various parameters, so the results of the workout may vary depending from the position you have on the machine. This is particularly evident when you need to do an exercise facing with your back the monitor, while you instead face the monitor (like triceps extension). The machine won't record correctly the exercise because your position is incorrect, but it has no way to know that (also why recording many exercises facing away from the monitor, if you need to look at the monitor for guidance?)
2) the overall program is made as sequence but the machine has no clue that you are switching between exercises. Basically it just play constantly the various exercises, and does not account for example that if you need to attach the barbell or the incline bench, you need time to do that. Same if you have to swap the position of the cable attachment from the top to the bottom section. You have to pause the exercise routine manually, make the changes and then push play again; and this is quite a pain especially if you are laying down and need to reach the screen to press play... Because the bluetooth ring is useless in this case, as it does not pause and unpause the exercise routine.
The other issues are related to the poor quality of the Bluetooth ring itself, which most of the time get disconnected and the wheel get stuck; and the fact that the attachments are really of cheap quality, considering how much you pay for the machine. The machine itself and the screen are great, so I am not sure why they made such cheap accessories.
The rowing bench for example is really poor quality and started to squeak after 2 days of usage; while the incline bench already show signs of having the thread where you screw in the knobs to fix the foldable legs in being ruined; because you have to remove completely the screw to fold the legs (not sure who had that brilliant idea to make that design; instead of using the same design used for the sliding mechanism of the back of the incline bench).
Another little flaw is that the cable attachment can only connect on the floor board in one position; which makes it hard to use a lot of attachments unless you are perfectly in the middle of the floor board.
Overall a good item that serve its purpose and that will be helpful to keep you engaged; especially if you like to "gamify" your physical activity (the rowing part is quite fun); although the experience is totally disconnected from what you do, as the machine does not have any interactive feature beside recording the movements of the cables. Does not record the pressure on the plate when you stand on it, as a simple wii board that cost 100 dollars could do 10 years ago, nor is able to record your movements using a smart watch connection or even its own ring. I was expecting a bit more in terms of interactivity but what you get is pretty good value, if you get the machine at a good discount.
Once folded it is really taking no space at all; so if you are short on space, it is a great machine. Although the rowing seat does not fold and it is big and heavy, so keep that in mind.

Genel olarak harika bir makine, birkaç haftadır kullanıyorum ve olumlu ve olumsuz yanları var.
Olumlu yönlerden, yapabileceğiniz egzersizler açısından size bir ton varyant sunmakta gerçekten iyidir; ve dahil edilen yazılım bir aboneliğin arkasına kilitlenmediğinden hepsi ücretsizdir. Uzun zamandır ilk kez bir ürünün bitmiş ve eksiksiz olarak satıldığını görüyorum. Diğer şirketler sizden aylık bir ücret ödemenizi ister, ancak bu bunun yerine bunu yapmaz. Belki bu değişecektir, ancak şimdilik, makine sizin için mevcut tüm egzersizlerle tamamen kilidi açılmış olarak satılıyor.
Negatiflere gelince, oldukça açık olduğunu düşündüğüm 2 tane var:
1) yazılımın ne yaptığınız hakkında hiçbir fikri yok: video sürekli arka planda oynatılıyor, bu nedenle bir egzersiz yaptığınızda egzersizi yapıp yapmadığınızı veya beklendiği gibi yapıp yapmadığınızı bilmenin bir yolu yok. Kablo gerginliği ve uzatma makineye çeşitli parametreleri söyleyecektir, bu nedenle antrenmanın sonuçları makinede sahip olduğunuz pozisyona bağlı olarak değişebilir. Bu, özellikle monitöre bakarken (triseps uzantısı gibi) monitöre bakacak şekilde bir egzersiz yapmanız gerektiğinde belirgindir. Makine, pozisyonunuz yanlış olduğu için egzersizi doğru bir şekilde kaydetmez, ancak bunu bilmenin bir yolu yoktur (ayrıca rehberlik için monitöre bakmanız gerekiyorsa, neden birçok egzersizi monitörden uzağa bakacak şekilde kaydetmelisiniz?)
2) genel program sıra olarak yapılır, ancak makinenin egzersizler arasında geçiş yaptığınıza dair hiçbir fikri yoktur. Temel olarak sadece çeşitli egzersizleri sürekli oynar ve örneğin halteri veya eğimli bankı takmanız gerekirse, bunu yapmak için zamana ihtiyacınız olduğunu hesaba katmaz. Kablo bağlantısının konumunu yukarıdan alt bölüme değiştirmeniz gerekiyorsa aynıdır. Egzersiz rutinini manuel olarak duraklatmanız, değişiklikleri yapmanız ve ardından tekrar oynatmaya basmanız gerekir; ve özellikle uzanıyorsanız ve oynat'a basmak için ekrana ulaşmanız gerekiyorsa bu oldukça acı verici... Çünkü bluetooth halkası bu durumda işe yaramaz, çünkü egzersiz rutinini duraklatmaz ve duraklatmaz.
Diğer sorunlar, çoğu zaman bağlantısı kesilen ve tekerleğin sıkıştığı Bluetooth halkasının kalitesizliği ile ilgilidir; ve makine için ne kadar ödediğiniz düşünüldüğünde ataşmanların gerçekten ucuz kalitede olması gerçeğidir. Makinenin kendisi ve ekran harika, bu yüzden neden bu kadar ucuz aksesuarlar yaptıklarından emin değilim.
Örneğin kürek tezgahı gerçekten kalitesiz ve 2 günlük kullanımdan sonra gıcırdamaya başladı; eğimli tezgah zaten katlanabilir ayakları sabitlemek için düğmeleri vidaladığınız dişin bozulduğuna dair işaretler gösteriyor; çünkü bacakları katlamak için vidayı tamamen çıkarmanız gerekiyor (bu tasarımı yapmak için kimin harika fikri olduğundan emin değilim; eğimli tezgahın arkasındaki kayma mekanizması için kullanılan aynı tasarımı kullanmak yerine).
Diğer bir küçük kusur, kablo bağlantısının zemin tahtasına yalnızca bir konumda bağlanabilmesidir; bu, zemin tahtasının tam ortasında olmadığınız sürece çok sayıda ataşman kullanmayı zorlaştırır.
Genel olarak amacına hizmet eden ve sizi meşgul etmenize yardımcı olacak iyi bir öğe; özellikle fiziksel aktivitenizi “oyunlaştırmayı” seviyorsanız (kürek çekme kısmı oldukça eğlencelidir); ancak deneyim yaptığınız işten tamamen kopmuş olsa da, makinede kabloların hareketlerini kaydetmenin yanı sıra herhangi bir etkileşimli özelliği yoktur. 100 dolara mal olan basit bir wii kartının 10 yıl önce yapabileceği gibi, üzerinde durduğunuzda plaka üzerindeki baskıyı kaydetmez ve akıllı saat bağlantısını veya hatta kendi halkasını kullanarak hareketlerinizi kaydedemez. Etkileşim açısından biraz daha fazlasını bekliyordum ama makineyi iyi bir indirimle alırsanız elde ettiğiniz şey oldukça iyi bir değer.
Katlandıktan sonra gerçekten hiç yer kaplamaz; yani yeriniz kısıtlıysa, harika bir makinedir. Kürek koltuğu katlanmasa ve büyük ve ağır olmasına rağmen, bunu aklınızda bulundurun.

us.textOriginal:
Love my Speediance Gym Monster!
I received my Speediance Gym Monster about two weeks ago.  I had been on the fence about buying it for a while, but am so happy with my decision to purchase it.
The unit arrived extremely well-packaged and secure.  Despite the box being very large, I was able to get the unit out with only a little assistance from my wife.  As advertised, it was ready to use right out of the box.
Here are some of the features that I’ve been enjoying most since I began using it:
• The assortment of training programs.  I have been a member of several gyms in the past.  One of my challenges has always been finding a good routine to follow.  With so many choices in a gym, I’ve easily gotten overwhelmed by my choices.  So, I would basically “graze”  in the gym – I’d wander from one machine to another with no direction of what to do.  I wasn’t the best at recording my workouts, either, so I rarely knew what I had done in prior workouts to see if I had made any improvements.
The assortment of training programs that are embedded in the Speediance ecosystem, eliminated this obstacle.  There are plenty of workout programs to choose from and each tells me what I need to do and which days I need to do it.  Some programs range from 3x per week to daily.  The choice is mine.  I also love that I don’t have to worry about whether the weight is right for me or not.  I did a preassessment of my strengths, and Speediance’s AI Coach made recommendations on how much weight is appropriate for me.  It’s not always 100% on the nose.  There have been some exercises that start me off way too heavy for my current fitness level. But in those instances, I can just make a quick adjustment on the fly to the weight and I’m ready to go.
• The spotter function has been exceptional.  Challenging myself with heavier weights at home can be challenging.  With the spotter function, I feel safe and confident in pushing and increasing my limits because I know that the machine will automatically lighten the resistance if it feels that I am struggling.  It has two settings of assistance, also, so I can adjust when I want the AI to jump in to help me.  Having the ability to adjust the weight on the fly allows me to maintain focus on completing my sets and challenges me in a meaningful way.
• The Gym Monster is not an inexpensive unit, but it's nice not to have additional monthly subscription fees to worry about.  I received a lifetime membership with my purchase.  I've read that at some point in the future Speediance may move to a subscription program, but I haven't experienced that.  I hope that they keep the included lifetime membership in the future as it is a big differentiator from other competitors like Tonal.
Now the buying through Amazon experience.  I had read that some people had poor experiences purchasing their units through Amazon.  I read often that people didn't receive the benches that should have been included with their packages.  I decided to roll the dice in the hopes that I would not have that experience, but unfortunately, it wasn't the best buying experience.
Ordering through Amazon was easy.  I purchased the Family package which includes a standard flat bench plus the rowing bench.  I scheduled a delivery date and time, and those too went fine.  The main unit was handled professionally by the delivery drivers and they placed the box in the front of our home.  However, as I began unboxing everything I realized that they hadn't included my rowing bench as advertised.
It wasn't a frustrating experience, just disappointing.  I called Amazon to explain my situation and to see if they could ship me the rowing unit separately.  The Amazon reps I spoke with were both top-notch, very understanding, and kind, and they did try to find a solution for me.  Unfortunately, though, they were unable to resolve the matter.  The only solution they came up with was to return the original unit and reorder another so that it would ship again, hopefully with the correct pieces this time.  I opted not to go this route.
I reached out via email directly to Speediance's customer service team.  Communication was via email since I didn't find any phone number to contact them.  Thankfully, the Speediance customer service team responded to my email inquiry within 24 hours and they were very understanding and apologetic for the inconvenience.  They offered to speak with their Amazon counterparts to confirm my order.  They were able to arrange for a rowing bench to be sent to me, which I received about a week after the original unit was delivered.  I have nothing but good things to say about Speediance's customer service.
In summary, wholeheartedly recommend purchasing a Gym Monster if you're looking for a good at-home smart gym.  Very pleased with my decision!

Speediance ekosistemine gömülü eğitim programlarının çeşitliliği bu engeli ortadan kaldırdı. Aralarından seçim yapabileceğiniz çok sayıda egzersiz programı var ve her biri bana ne yapmam gerektiğini ve hangi günlerde yapmam gerektiğini söylüyor. Bazı programlar haftada 3 ila günlük arasında değişir. Seçim benim. Ayrıca kilonun benim için uygun olup olmadığı konusunda endişelenmem gerekmemesini seviyorum. Şu anki fitness seviyem için beni çok ağır başlatan bazı egzersizler oldu. Ancak bu durumlarda, anında ağırlığa hızlı bir ayarlama yapabilirim ve gitmeye hazırım.
• Gözetleme işlevi olağanüstü olmuştur. Evde daha ağır ağırlıklarla kendime meydan okumak zor olabilir. Gözetleme işlevi ile sınırlarımı zorlama ve artırma konusunda kendimi güvende ve güvende hissediyorum çünkü makinenin mücadele ettiğimi hissederse direnci otomatik olarak hafifleteceğini biliyorum. Ayrıca iki yardım ayarı var, böylece yapay zekanın bana yardım etmesi için ne zaman atlamasını istediğimi ayarlayabilirim. Ağırlığı anında ayarlama yeteneğine sahip olmak, setlerimi tamamlamaya odaklanmamı sağlıyor ve beni anlamlı bir şekilde zorluyor.
• Gym Monster ucuz bir birim değildir, ancak endişelenecek ek aylık abonelik ücretlerinin olmaması güzel. Satın alma işlemimle ömür boyu üyelik aldım. Gelecekte bir noktada Speediance"in bir abonelik programına geçebileceğini okudum, ama bunu deneyimlemedim. Tonal gibi diğer rakiplerden büyük bir farklılaştırıcı olduğu için gelecekte dahil edilen ömür boyu üyeliği koruyacaklarını umuyorum..
Şimdi Amazon deneyimi aracılığıyla satın alma. Bazı insanların birimlerini Amazon üzerinden satın alma deneyimlerinin kötü olduğunu okumuştum. İnsanların paketlerine dahil edilmesi gereken bankları almadıklarını sık sık okudum. Bu deneyime sahip olmayacağım umuduyla zar atmaya karar verdim, ama ne yazık ki, en iyi satın alma deneyimi değildi.
Amazon üzerinden sipariş vermek kolaydı. Standart bir düz tezgah ve kürek tezgahı içeren Aile paketini satın aldım. Bir teslimat tarihi ve saati planladım, ve bunlar da iyi gitti. Ana ünite teslimat sürücüleri tarafından profesyonelce ele alındı ve kutuyu evimizin önüne yerleştirdiler. ancak, her şeyi kutudan çıkarmaya başladığımda, reklamı yapılan gibi kürek tezgahımı dahil etmediklerini fark ettim.
Sinir bozucu bir deneyim değildi, sadece hayal kırıklığı. Durumumu açıklamak ve kürek ünitesini ayrı ayrı gönderip gönderemeyeceklerini görmek için Amazon"u aradım. Konuştuğum Amazon temsilcileri hem birinci sınıf, çok anlayışlı hem de nazikti ve benim için bir çözüm bulmaya çalıştılar. Ne yazık ki, meseleyi çözemediler. Buldukları tek çözüm, orijinal birimi iade etmek ve tekrar gönderilmesi için bir başkasını yeniden sipariş etmekti, umarım bu sefer doğru parçalarla. Bu yoldan gitmemeyi seçtim.
Speediance'in müşteri hizmetleri ekibine doğrudan e-posta yoluyla ulaştım. Onlarla iletişim kurmak için herhangi bir telefon numarası bulamadığım için iletişim e-posta yoluyla yapıldı. Neyse ki, Speediance müşteri hizmetleri ekibi e-posta sorgumu 24 saat içinde yanıtladı ve rahatsızlıktan dolayı çok anlayışlı ve özür dilediler. Siparişimi onaylamak için Amazon meslektaşlarıyla konuşmayı teklif ettiler. Orijinal ünite teslim edildikten yaklaşık bir hafta sonra aldığım bir kürek tezgahının bana gönderilmesini ayarlayabildiler. Speediance'in müşteri hizmetleri hakkında söyleyecek güzel şeylerden başka bir şeyim yok.
Özetle, evde iyi bir akıllı spor salonu arıyorsanız, gönülden bir Gym Monster satın almanızı öneririz. Kararımdan çok memnun kaldım!

us.headline: Exactly what I wanted!
us.textOriginal:
I have been working on for years and a home gym is among the first things I planned after moving into my current a house.
I have an older house with basement measured at 7 feet tall. So my options were pretty limited: either a super low rack or half rack, or one of these versatile machines. For me, it was between this and Tonal. I'll list the things that turned me away from Tonal and also the things I loved about my Speediance Gym Monster.
To get a Tonal:
1. Initial cost ends up being around $4,800 for me, doubling what I paid for my Gym Monster
2. Tonal is fixed to a wall of selection and requires installation, extra cost for installation and removal had you decide to move or change the machine to a different location. For me, this is even less flexible than a traditional home gym setup
3. $60/month subscription fee. I absolutely hating subscription models. The feeling of owning the machine but can't use all of it unless you pay $60 more a month is beyond me. Also, Tonal increased the monthly fee from $50 to $60. They can simply increase the fee in the future
Things I love about Gym Monster so far:
1. Build quality is very good, platform is very sturdy. Accessories are well made as well, especially the adjustable barbell
2. Easy to move around with the wheels. I already moved it around twice since I got it and I moved it alone
3. Free lifetime membership, at least if you buy now. The community group on FB is very engaging and you can tell that the Speediance team listens to its customers, appreciates and implement changes based on feedback from customers
4. It's not as "intimidating" as a traditional setup to those that just look to casually work out. In this case it would be my partner. The partner mode is great given how easy it is to change weight on the same exercise
It is exactly what I wanted and I highly recommend this machine.

us.headline: Compact, Versatile
us.textOriginal:
I was worried based on other reviews that I would receive my machine on the scheduled date or that the incline bench would be missing. Luckily, neither of those things were anything to be worried about! The incline bench came in the same box as the Gym Monster and on the day that was scheduled.  The delivery drivers weren't super prepared for the delivery and I did have to help them to get it up my front steps and into my entryway. It is VERY heavy (over 200lbs) but once you open the box and take the bench and accessories out, it's easy to stand upright.
The machine itself is great and I love how compact and mobile it is. It was the main selling point for me when comparing it to similar systems. The machine is quiet and is perfect for apartment dwellers. So far the workouts have been great but I would say to just try light weights when first using the straps because 40lbs on a traditional machine is not the same on the gym monster! I almost strung myself up on my first go-round. The safety/assist features are amazing but I wish there was a way to set it globally. It seems that I have to turn it on each time I work out and sometimes I forget. I also wish the yoga mat stayed on the platform when folded (you can see in my photo what happens to it) and one of the magnets already peeled off the mat.
Overall I am so excited about this machine and I think it'll help me stay consistent -- I have social anxiety so going to the gym is difficult and I don't always want to lift my bowflex weights up and down. This gives great variety to routines and the lifetime membership and classes alone are worth it!

PELOTON x3) but wanted something that was really dedicated to resistance training and building strength but wouldn’t take up a large footprint.

Great purchase!

The workout selection looks to be very broad and pretty easy to follow even for beginners. I have not tried a full program yet so I don't have any feedback on that at the moment but looking forward to see how they can be used by inexperienced users such as my parents.
Compared to the Tonal this has the benefits of lifetime membership fee for now (hopefully forever) and does not have to be perma attached to a wall. It does not yet have live classes or software parody but everything so far is great and it has a nice big screen with the really useful tilt and flip feature. I recently bought the Speediance Smart Gym and I’m really happy with it. The gym is easy to use and has lots of smart design features (hardware and software) that makes it super flexible for different workouts.  I sync it with my Apple fitness/watch and it's nice that there's a Speediance app too.
Multiple family profiles is great for me with more than one person using it regularly. Customer service is very responsive and the delivery was surprisingly fast (arrived in days and much earlier than expected). IMHO This gym competes really well with the more well-known Tonal (initial and ongoing costs, more effective use of space, ease of installation/mobility).
The current promotion of free lifetime membership right now made it easy to take the plunge. For my budget this was a pretty big investment.  I did a ton of research before purchasing and have no regrets. Their software and workout library continues to get enhanced.  I'd love to see subtitles functionality added during workouts.
To summarize, so far my experience has been excellent, both with product and the company support. For this kind of investment, the company being responsive and standing by their product has been important to me. Buying from Amazon was another layer of comfort/protection for me.
This review is after almost a month of usage.  It's rare I take the time to provide a detailed product review, but felt I had to given how impressed I've been with this one. I plan to update my review if anything changes significantly.  For anyone considering a smart gym in this range, I'd strongly recommend Speediance's solution.

us.headline: Outstanding Product That Shipped FAST!
us.textOriginal:
I'm new to lifting weights and did my homework before making the decision to purchase this gym. I was most nervous about the delivery dates since reading what other buyers had to say online from other websites; however, the gym was at my house BEFORE the delivery date. Additionally, the the shipping company was informative and reached out to me regarding updates. The service actually called me to schedule an appointment rather fast, and I initially ignored their calls thinking they were spam.
You can watch videos on YouTube that share how easy this gym is to unbox. I will say, though, one needs an extra set of hands to get this up the steps if there is no elevator. The box is HEAVY (which speaks to the durability of the product)! Once out of the box, the Speediance Gym Monster feels lighter and less intimidating. It's easy to stand up and move around--and I'm a skinny guy who weighs 125 pounds.
Right now.  :)
The gym paired easily with my wifi and information I entered on the Speediance phone app prior to arrival. The bluetooth feature is handy and connects with the push of a button after holding down the bluetooth icon on the home screen to show the paired items.
Again, I am new to lifting weights, so the videos and safety features are a tremendous help. My cousin has been strength training for a little over seven months with a personal trainer (I'm a teacher and can't afford one of those) and was impressed with the versatility of the machine.
I look forward to working out now and am glad to have made this purchase.

de.textOriginal:
Zunächst: Ich habe das Teil selbst gekauft und wurde nicht zu einer Rezension aufgefordert.
Ich habe das Speediance Gym Monster zwar erst seit ein paar Tagen aber ich kann bereits jetzt schon sagen, dass ich total begeistert und motiviert bin. Ich war früher im Fitness-Studio aber ich mochte nicht, dass die Griffe an den Geräten nie gereinigt werden und mir auch niemand assistiert. Außerdem war ich letztlich immer zu faul mich auf den Weg zu machen.
Das ist beim Gym Monster anders. Klar, im Vergleich zum Fitti amortisiert sich das Investment je nach monatlicher Gebühr erst in 5-10 Jahren (vergesst nicht die künftigen Preissteigerungen bei der Rechnung 😉), aber das ist mir egal, denn für mich heißt es: Entweder garnichts machen oder eben zuhause für mich. Ins Fitti wollte ich nicht.
Ich habe lange überlegt bzgl. der hohen Anschaffung, aber es nicht bereut. Was mich letztlich überzeugt hat den Schritt zu gehen:
- Solide verarbeitet
- Eigentlich nur gute Reviews (okay, die meisten haben auch einen Gutscheincode und sind daher vermutlich nicht ganz neutral)
- Ich habe einen Personal-Coach der mir die passenden Gewichte auflegt, mich motiviert und mir die Übungen vormacht, wenn ich das möchte. Ich kann mir selbst einen Trainingsplan zusammenstellen oder einen vorgeschlagenen Plan befolgen. Ich kann aber auch einfach freie Übungen machen.
- Wenig Platzbedarf
- Großer (schwenkbarer) Bildschirm den ich auch ohne Lesebrille ablesen kann
- Es gibt einen Offline-Modus (freies Training), falls die Firma irgendwann die Server abschaltet
- Genaues Tracking meiner Leistungen und Übermittlung in Apple Aktivitäten bzw. Health
- Es wird die Herzfrequenz der Apple Watch am Bildschirm angezeigt
- Sehr netter und auskunftsfreudiger Kundendienst
- Schnelle Lieferung: Um 15 Uhr bestellt, kam am Folgetag um 7:15 per Spedition (die Jungs haben sich aber verweigert den 100 kg Karton (ohne Tragegriffe) durchs enge Treppenhaus in den ersten Stock zu tragen, obwohl Lieferung an Wunschort 😬). Ausgepackt kann man das Teil aber zu zweit hochwuchten.
- Bei einer Bestellung über Amazon gibt es 30 Tage Rückgaberecht (auf der Händlerseite nur 14 Tage) und mir war es recht Amazon als Vermittler dazwischen zu haben
Zum Gerät:
Alles sehr stabil und schwer ausgeführt (selbst die Bank). Erfüllt genau meine Erwartungen an ein hochwertiges Produkt. Einer der Lüfter surrt etwas unangenehm, aber während des Workouts hört man das eher nicht, nur wenn man seitlich daneben steht. Wenn ich es nicht benutze schalte ich es mit dem richtigen Schalter aus. Die deutschen Übersetzungen sind von okay über amüsant bis hin zu verwirrend - aber daran kann der Hersteller ja noch arbeiten. Es kommen übrigens regelmäßig Updates (das konnte ich schon bei der App verfolgen und das Gerät musste direkt ein paar Versionsnummern überspringen um auf den neusten Stand zu kommen). Die Inbetriebnahme ist einfach. Und ja, es gibt eine lebenslange Mitgliedschaft ohne Kosten. Es wird aber vielleicht künftig zusätzliche (KI?) Funktionen geben, die dann kostenpflichtig sein können. Aktuell gibt es bereits eine "KI" für die Gewichtsempfehlungen anhand des bisherigen Verhaltens. Die Kurse sind gut umgesetzt. Das 3D-Rudern im Kanal finde ich besonders cool. Durch die digitalen (mit Motoren erzeugten) Gewichte gibt Trainingsmodi die im Fitti so kaum möglich sind:
- Kette: Je weiter man zieht, desto schwerer wird es
- Exzentrisch: Bei der Rückwärtsbewegung wird Gewicht drauf gelegt
- Konstante Geschwindigkeit: Wenn man schneller wird, wirds schwerer oder wenn man langsamer wird, wiederum leichter
Zusätzlich gibt es einen "Assistent" der einem helfen kann Gewicht runter zu nehmen, wenn die letzten Übungen unsauber werden. Es gibt eine kleiner Fernbedienung in Form eines Bluetooth Rings (Gewicht bestimmen und Start/Stopp). Bei der Stange erkennt das Gerät, wenn man schräg hält und schaltet die Gewichte sofort ab.
Dadurch, dass man die Seile sowohl vertikal wie auch in der Bodenplatte einhängen kann, gibt es eigentlich keine Muskelpartie die man damit nicht trainieren kann. Schaut Euch die Videos dazu an und überzeugt Euch selbst. Auf der Herstellerseite kann man auch eine remote Vorführung buchen.
=> Ich kann es uneingeschränkt bisher empfehlen. Die Langzeiterfahrung fehlt aber noch, muss ich fairerweise sagen.

Her şey çok kararlıydı ve yürütülmesi zordu (banka bile). Yüksek kaliteli bir ürün için beklentilerimi tam olarak karşılıyor. Hayranlardan biri biraz rahatsız edici bir şekilde dönüyor, ancak egzersiz sırasında, tam yanında dururken duymama eğilimindeysiniz. Kullanmadığımda, sağ anahtarla kapatıyorum. Almanca çeviriler tamamdan eğlenceye ve kafa karıştırıcıya kadar değişiyor - ancak üretici hala bunun üzerinde çalışabilir. Bu arada, düzenli güncellemeler var (bunu uygulama ile zaten izleyebildim ve cihaz güncel olmak için hemen birkaç sürüm numarasını atlamak zorunda kaldı). Kurulumu kolaydır. Ve evet, ücretsiz ömür boyu üyelik var. Ancak ek olabilir (AI?) Gelecekte Daha sonra ödenebilecek işlevler var. Şu anda önceki davranışlara dayalı ağırlık önerileri için zaten bir “AI” var. Kurslar iyi uygulanmıştır. Bir kanalda 3D kürek çekmeyi özellikle havalı buluyorum. Dijital ağırlıklar (motorlarla üretilir) Fitti'de pek mümkün olmayan eğitim modları sağlar:

- Eksantrik: Geriye doğru hareket ederken üzerine ağırlık yerleştirilir

ca.headline: Good product, poor ring control.
ca.textOriginal:
5-star to the design, build quality, and customer support. 0 star to the Bluetooth ring, which is the primary load control.
The Bluetooth ring had a connection issue on its first day. Contacted customer support, and they immediately shipped a new one.  You know what? The replacement ring is even worse!!
After a month of use, I've found that you must stay within 1 meter of the antenna—any further and the connection drops. Put your water bottle next to the machine base if you don't want to manually reconnect after drinking. Be patient when you are doing workouts back-facing the screen cause the Bluetooth signal may be blocked by your body. When you press the button, the ring is also struggling to connect.
Worse still, the ring’s intermittent connectivity isn’t just a nuisance—it can be a safety hazard. One day, I was doing 90kg barbell squats in manual mode, so I had to deactivate the weights by the ring. The ring disconnected at the end, leaving me stranded with a 90 kg load on my trapezius and no one around to help until it reconnected after 30 seconds. It was a scary 30 seconds!
While the Gym Monster boasts elegant design and decent build quality, the faulty Bluetooth ring undermines the experience of a CAD$4000 product. Speediance urgently needs to recall and upgrade these rings before someone gets seriously hurt—or before a class action follows.

ca.headline: Life-changing product
ca.textOriginal:
Speediance might have not invented the smart home gym, but they made it available to the masses.
I am the type of guy who has paid for a gym membership for the past 4 years and have been a total of about 10 times in that time. With 2 kids, a full time job and the challenges of daily life, I never had time to go to the gym. And the odd time I went, I was intimidated by the people waiting for machines. Who wants to chest press 75lbs while the guy before was using 200lbs? That's not to mention if another guy stands next to me waiting for me to be done. Then, I really felt the pressure to either finish quickly or leave. That's not to mention sitting on equipment used by someone else and not wiped clean.
Well, the Speediance Gym Monster fixed all that. Now, I have my own machine that does everything I need in terms of strength training. I waited 2 months before posting a review, and here's my assessment so far :
1) The convenience of being able to work out for 15 or 20 mins whenever you have free time is amazing. It let's me squeeze in a few movements here and there that I would've never been able to do in a gym because of lack of time.
2) The resistance is accurate in term of weight, but if "feels" even heavier than static weights because it's actually pulling against you.
3) I have managed to visibly build muscle in 2 months while only working out 3 times a week for about 30-40 minutes.
4) There's pre-made workouts for beginners like me. It starts you off with some targeted stretches to reduce the risk of injury while working out. It also gives you breaks between movements and finishes your workout with more stretches.
5) The developpers actually update the software to make it better. You're not buying a machine that will be stuck in 2025 for 6 years.
6) The machine will start you off with small weights and calculate how easy you're doing the reps. It will gradually increase the weight until it senses you're actually struggling. It will store all that info for the next time you work that specific muscle group. Considering I used to go to the gym once every 3 months, I used to have to write down how much I can handle of every machine. No more of that nonsense.
7) I have increased the weights I can lift by about 40% in 2 months. I was stagnant for 3 years because I wasn't regular enough. Now, there's no excuse not to work out for 15-20 mins before a shower a few times a week.
8) The machine lets you create different profiles for different users. My wife has her weight data and presets, I have mine.
Overall, it's a beautiful product that has changed how I see strength training and that will certainly have a deep impact on my health on the long run.

Speediance akıllı ev spor salonunu icat etmemiş olabilir, ancak kitlelerin kullanımına sundular.
Son 4 yıldır spor salonu üyeliği için ödeme yapan ve o süre içinde toplamda yaklaşık 10 kez olan bir adamım. 2 çocuk, tam zamanlı bir iş ve günlük yaşamın zorlukları ile spor salonuna gitmek için hiç vaktim olmadı. Ve gittiğim tuhaf zamanda, makineleri bekleyen insanlar beni korkuttu. Daha önceki adam 200 lbs kullanırken kim 75 kilo göğsüne baskı yapmak ister? Yanımda başka bir adam durup bitmemi bekleyip durmadığından bahsetmiyorum bile. Sonra, Ya çabuk bitirme ya da ayrılma baskısını hissettim. Başka biri tarafından kullanılan ve silinmeyen ekipmanların üzerinde oturmaktan bahsetmiyorum bile.
İyi, Speediance Spor Salonu Canavarı tüm bunları düzeltti. Şimdi, kuvvet antrenmanı açısından ihtiyacım olan her şeyi yapan kendi makinem var. Bir inceleme göndermeden önce 2 ay bekledim ve şu ana kadarki değerlendirmem:
1) Boş zamanınız olduğunda 15 veya 20 dakika egzersiz yapabilmenin rahatlığı harika. Zaman yetersizliğinden dolayı spor salonunda asla yapamayacağım birkaç hareketi burada ve orada yapmama izin verdi.
2) Direnç ağırlık açısından doğrudur, ancak statik ağırlıklardan bile daha ağır “hissedilir” çünkü aslında size karşı çekiyor.
3) Haftada sadece 3 kez yaklaşık 30-40 dakika egzersiz yaparken 2 ayda gözle görülür şekilde kas inşa etmeyi başardım.
4) Benim gibi yeni başlayanlar için önceden hazırlanmış egzersizler var. Egzersiz yaparken yaralanma riskini azaltmak için bazı hedefli gerilmelerle başlamanızı sağlar. Ayrıca hareketler arasında molalar verir ve antrenmanınızı daha fazla esnemeyle bitirir.
5) Geliştiriciler aslında yazılımı daha iyi hale getirmek için günceller. 2025'te 6 yıl takılı kalacak bir makine satın almıyorsunuz.
6) Makine sizi küçük ağırlıklarla başlatacak ve tekrarları ne kadar kolay yaptığınızı hesaplayacaktır. Gerçekten mücadele ettiğinizi hissedene kadar ağırlığı kademeli olarak artıracaktır. Bu belirli kas grubunu bir dahaki sefere çalıştırdığınızda tüm bu bilgileri saklayacaktır. Her 3 ayda bir spor salonuna gittiğimi düşünürsek, her makineden ne kadar başa çıkabileceğimi yazmam gerekiyordu. Artık bu saçmalıklara gerek yok.
7) Kaldırabildiğim ağırlıkları 2 ayda yaklaşık% 40 artırdım. Yeterince düzenli olmadığım için 3 yıl durgundum. Şimdi, haftada birkaç kez duştan önce 15-20 dakika egzersiz yapmamak için hiçbir bahane yok.
8) Makine, farklı kullanıcılar için farklı profiller oluşturmanıza izin verir. Karımın kilo verileri ve ön ayarları var, benimki var.
Genel olarak, kuvvet antrenmanını nasıl gördüğümü değiştiren ve uzun vadede sağlığım üzerinde kesinlikle derin bir etkisi olacak güzel bir ürün.

pl.headline: Speediance Gym Monster
pl.textOriginal: Cudowne urządzenie. To, co oferuje Gym Monster, przerosło moje oczekiwania. Kompaktowa, nowoczesna, zaawansowana technologicznie i łatwa w obsłudze siłownia typu „wszystko w jednym”. Zaczynam swoją przygodę z treningiem siłowym i widzę, że jest mi on naprawdę potrzebny. Po kilku dniach stosowania odkrywam mięśnie, których nie używałem i dlatego są bardzo słabe. Mimo że amatorsko ćwiczę jazdę na rowerze, moja górna część ciała nie jest wytrenowana. Już widzę, że Speediance Gym Monster to dla mnie idealne rozwiązanie. Co więcej, mój siedemnastoletni syn założył już konto i zaczął ćwiczyć. Może więc przydać się całej rodzinie. Polecam każdemu, kto chce rozwijać swoją sylwetkę w zaciszu własnego domu.
pl.textTr: Harika cihaz. Gym Monster"ın sunduğu şey beklentilerimi aştı. Kompakt, modern, yüksek teknolojili ve kullanımı kolay hepsi bir arada spor salonu. Amatörce bisiklet sürme pratiği yapmama rağmen, üst bedenim eğitilmedi. Speediance Gym Monster'ın benim için mükemmel bir çözüm olduğunu zaten görebiliyorum. Dahası, on yedi yaşındaki oğlum zaten bir hesap oluşturdu ve pratik yapmaya başladı. Bu yüzden tüm aile için faydalı olabilir. Kendi evinin rahatlığında figürünü büyütmek isteyen herkese tavsiye ederim.
